title: Shaders: make ShaderGlobalsOverride apply and revert global uniform overrides from the scene tree
description:
[audit-key: shaders/shader-globals-override-node] [port-audit 2026-07-27] [status: STUB]

**Godot ground truth:** upstream/godot/scene/main/shader_globals_override.cpp — on NOTIFICATION_ENTER_TREE the node calls RenderingServer.global_shader_parameter_set_override for each `params/<name>` property; on EXIT_TREE it clears them; only one active override wins per parameter

**Godot classes:** ShaderGlobalsOverride, RenderingServer

**Patina today:**
- [shaders] The class is registered as a bare Node with no properties and no methods — crates/gdobject/src/class_db.rs:4284 `register_class(ClassRegistration::new("ShaderGlobalsOverride").parent("Node"))`. No node-side behavior exists anywhere: `grep -rn ShaderGlobalsOverride --include=*.rs crates/` returns only that registration, a ClassDB-existence assertion at crates/gdscene/src/render_server_3d.rs:2517, an inspector schema row at crates/gdeditor/src/inspector_schema_generated.rs:5053, and two doc comments. The override plumbing it is supposed to drive exists and is reachable only from script: `grep -rn shader_globals::set_override --include=*.rs crates/` returns a single caller, crates/gdscript-interop/src/interpreter.rs:6577 (the RenderingServer method). So placing a ShaderGlobalsOverride node in a .tscn overrides nothing.

**Files:** /Users/bone/dev/games/patina/engine-rs/crates/gdobject/src/class_db.rs, /Users/bone/dev/games/patina/engine-rs/crates/gdvariant/src/shader_globals.rs, /Users/bone/dev/games/patina/engine-rs/crates/gdscene/src/render_server_3d.rs

**Implement / wiring requirement:**

GODOT GROUND TRUTH: scene/main/shader_globals_override.cpp exposes each project global shader parameter as a `params/<name>` property. On NOTIFICATION_ENTER_TREE the node pushes every set property through RenderingServer.global_shader_parameter_set_override; on NOTIFICATION_EXIT_TREE it clears them, restoring whatever the project file or a script last set. Only the first active override in the tree wins, and the node warns when a second one is added.

PATINA STATE: crates/gdobject/src/class_db.rs:4284 registers `ShaderGlobalsOverride` as a bare Node — no `params/*` properties, no methods, no notification handling. `grep -rn ShaderGlobalsOverride --include=*.rs crates/` finds no behavioral code at all; the only hits are the registration, a class-exists assertion (crates/gdscene/src/render_server_3d.rs:2517), an inspector schema entry (crates/gdeditor/src/inspector_schema_generated.rs:5053) and doc comments. The store it should drive is complete and already models the override slot separately from the base value (crates/gdvariant/src/shader_globals.rs:35-47, :102-111), but its only caller is the script-facing RenderingServer method at crates/gdscript-interop/src/interpreter.rs:6577.

APPROACH: (1) Generate the node's property list dynamically from `gdvariant::shader_globals::get_list()` as `params/<name>`, so the inspector shows one row per declared global (matching Godot's `_get_property_list`). (2) Hook NOTIFICATION_ENTER_TREE / NOTIFICATION_EXIT_TREE in the gdscene node lifecycle dispatch to call `gdvariant::shader_globals::set_override(name, Some(v))` / `set_override(name, None)` for each set property. (3) Track the active override node so a second one in the tree emits a configuration warning instead of silently fighting the first. (4) Make crates/gdscene/src/packed_scene.rs preserve `params/*` properties on load so a .tscn-authored override survives.

WIRING REQUIREMENT: adding the node to the tree must change the value a shader reads for that global uniform in the very next rendered frame, and removing it must restore the previous value.

**Prove it:** With project.godot declaring `[shader_globals] tint = {"type":"color","value":Color(1,0,0,1)}`, a .tscn whose ShaderGlobalsOverride sets `params/tint = Color(0,1,0,1)` renders a quad using `global uniform vec4 tint;` green while the node is in the tree and red after the node is removed; adding a second ShaderGlobalsOverride produces a configuration warning. (test: `shader_globals_override_node_applies_on_tree_enter`)
acceptance_criteria: With project.godot declaring `[shader_globals] tint = {"type":"color","value":Color(1,0,0,1)}`, a .tscn whose ShaderGlobalsOverride sets `params/tint = Color(0,1,0,1)` renders a quad using `global uniform vec4 tint;` green while the node is in the tree and red after the node is removed; adding a second ShaderGlobalsOverride produces a configuration warning. (test: `shader_globals_override_node_applies_on_tree_enter`)

title: Light2D: load occluders from the OccluderPolygon2D sub-resource and light from global transforms
description:
[audit-key: nodes-2d/light2d-scene-load] [port-audit 2026-07-27] [status: UNWIRED/PARTIAL]

**Godot ground truth:** upstream/godot/scene/2d/light_occluder_2d.cpp + light_2d.cpp; extension_api.json LightOccluder2D{occluder: OccluderPolygon2D, occluder_light_mask, sdf_collision}, OccluderPolygon2D{closed, cull_mode, polygon}, DirectionalLight2D{height, max_distance} (NO `direction` property), Light2D{range_z_min/max, range_layer_min/max}, PointLight2D{height} | upstream/godot/doc/classes/PointLight2D.xml (height, offset, texture, texture_scale — no `range`), DirectionalLight2D.xml (height, max_distance — direction comes from node rotation, no `direction` member), LightOccluder2D.xml (occluder: OccluderPolygon2D, occluder_light_mask, sdf_collision — no `polygon` member), Light2D.xml (range_z_min/max, range_layer_min/max) | extension_api.json .classes[] is the complete Godot 4.6.1 class set — it contains neither `VisualScript` (removed in Godot 4.0) nor `TcpMultiplayerPeer`. `.is_instantiable == false` marks the classes ClassDB::can_instantiate refuses: Light2D (upstream/godot/scene/register_scene_types.cpp:924 GDREGISTER_ABSTRACT_CLASS(Light2D)), Shape3D (register_scene_types.cpp:1020), DirAccess, FileAccess, MultiplayerAPI, RenderingDevice, SceneState, XRInterface, XRTracker, TileSetSource, InstancePlaceholder, WorkerThreadPool, JavaScriptBridge, JavaScriptObject, GDExtensionManager, EditorInterface, EditorFileSystem, EditorResourcePreview, IKModifier3D, VisualShaderNodeOutput, AudioEffectSpectrumAnalyzerInstance, AudioStreamGeneratorPlayback, AudioStreamPlaybackInteractive/Playlist/Polyphonic/Synchronized

**Godot classes:** Light2D, PointLight2D, DirectionalLight2D, LightOccluder2D, OccluderPolygon2D, Shape3D, DirAccess, FileAccess, MultiplayerAPI, RenderingDevice, SceneState, InstancePlaceholder, TileSetSource, WorkerThreadPool

**Patina today:**
- [nodes-2d] `crates/gdscene/src/light2d_scene.rs:146-155` reads `polygon`/`closed`/`light_mask` DIRECTLY off the LightOccluder2D node. Godot serializes the geometry as `occluder = SubResource("OccluderPolygon2D_x")`, and `crates/gdscene/src/packed_scene.rs` flattens no such companion — the full companion-prefix set is `__shape__ __material__ __canvas_material__ __physics_material__ __navmesh_* __viewport_mesh__ __viewport_shape__ __click_mask__ __sf_anims__ __extres__ __tile_set__ curve_points` (grep `rg -n '"__[a-z_]*__' crates/gdscene/src/packed_scene.rs`). So a real scene's occluder yields `Variant::Nil` for `polygon` -> `continue` at line 149 -> ZERO occluders -> no 2D shadows. The 'wiring' test that guards this hand-builds the node and sets `polygon` itself: `crates/gdscene/tests/light2d_scene_shading_wiring.rs:29-33`. `crates/gdrender2d/src/occluder_polygon.rs` (OccluderPolygon2D + cull_mode) has NO caller outside `pub use` in `crates/gdrender2d/src/lib.rs:41` (verified `rg --type rust -l -F 'occluder_polygon::'`). Also: `light2d_scene.rs:98` uses `node2d::get_position` (LOCAL) instead of `get_global_transform`, so a light parented under a moving Node2D lights the wrong world point; `light2d_scene.rs:120` reads a property named `direction` that does not exist in Godot's DirectionalLight2D, so every authored directional light falls back to (0,-1) regardless of node rotation; `height`, `max_distance`, `range_z_min/max`, `range_layer_min/max`, `sdf_collision` are read nowhere (`rg -n 'range_z_min|range_layer_min|max_distance|sdf_collision' crates/` = 0 outside class_db).
- [rendering-2d] `collect_lights_2d` reads a `range` property on PointLight2D (crates/gdscene/src/light2d_scene.rs:100-104) — Godot's PointLight2D has no such member; the footprint comes from texture size × texture_scale. It reads `direction` on DirectionalLight2D (light2d_scene.rs:120-124) — also not a Godot member; direction is the node's rotation. `light.texture_path` is collected (light2d_scene.rs:112-115) but never sampled: `light_factor_at` (crates/gdrender2d/src/light2d.rs:291-...) uses a radial falloff only; `grep -n 'texture_path' crates/gdrender2d/src/light2d.rs` shows the field is written at 204/245 and read nowhere. `collect_occluders_2d` requires a `polygon` PackedVector2Array on the node and reads `light_mask` (light2d_scene.rs:146-155); Godot serializes `occluder = SubResource("OccluderPolygon2D_x")` and `occluder_light_mask`, and `grep -rn 'occluder' crates/gdscene/src/packed_scene.rs` returns nothing — so no OccluderPolygon2D sub-resource is flattened and a real authored scene yields zero occluders (no 2D shadows). `range_z_min/range_z_max/range_layer_min/range_layer_max` and PointLight2D/DirectionalLight2D `height`, DirectionalLight2D `max_distance` are never read (`grep -rn 'range_z_min\|range_layer_min\|max_distance' crates/gdscene crates/gdrender2d` → no hits). `OccluderPolygon2D.cull_mode` exists in crates/gdrender2d/src/occluder_polygon.rs but `gdrender2d::light2d::LightOccluder2D` (light2d.rs:252-270) has no cull_mode field and the module has zero consumers beyond the re-export at crates/gdrender2d/src/lib.rs:41.
- [registered-class-member-depth] engine-rs/crates/gdobject/src/class_db.rs:3540 `register_class(ClassRegistration::new("VisualScript").parent("Resource"));` and :11554-11556 registers `TcpMultiplayerPeer` — neither name exists in Godot 4.6.1's extension_api.json, so `ClassDB.get_class_list()` and the editor Create Node dialog expose classes Godot does not have. Separately, parsing every non-test registration for `.abstract_class()` (the builder at class_db.rs:213) and joining against `.is_instantiable` shows 26 classes Godot refuses to instantiate that Patina will happily construct — including Light2D and Shape3D, which would appear as creatable nodes in the Create Node dialog (`create_node_catalog::can_instantiate` at engine-rs/crates/gdeditor/src/create_node_catalog.rs:52 is `class_db::instantiate(class_name).is_some()`). Note: the reverse direction (17 classes Patina marks abstract that extension_api reports instantiable, e.g. BaseButton/Material/Range) is Godot's virtual-vs-abstract distinction and is NOT claimed here.

**Files:** engine-rs/crates/gdscene/src/light2d_scene.rs, engine-rs/crates/gdscene/src/packed_scene.rs, engine-rs/crates/gdrender2d/src/occluder_polygon.rs, engine-rs/crates/gdeditor/src/viewport_2d_render.rs, engine-rs/crates/gdrender2d/src/light2d.rs, engine-rs/crates/gdobject/src/class_db.rs, engine-rs/crates/gdeditor/src/create_node_catalog.rs

**Implement / wiring requirement:**

GODOT: `LightOccluder2D` stores geometry in an `occluder: OccluderPolygon2D` sub-resource (`polygon`, `closed`, `cull_mode`) plus `occluder_light_mask` and `sdf_collision` (upstream/godot/scene/2d/light_occluder_2d.cpp). `DirectionalLight2D` has NO `direction` property — its light vector comes from the node's global rotation, with `height` and `max_distance` (scene/2d/light_2d.cpp `DirectionalLight2D::_notification`). `Light2D` adds `range_z_min/range_z_max/range_layer_min/range_layer_max`; `PointLight2D` adds `height`. Lights and occluders are placed by their GLOBAL canvas transform.

PATINA: `crates/gdscene/src/light2d_scene.rs:146-155` reads `polygon`/`closed`/`light_mask` straight off the node, so a Godot-authored `occluder = SubResource("OccluderPolygon2D_x")` produces no polygon and `collect_occluders_2d` returns empty — 2D shadows never appear from a real .tscn. `packed_scene.rs` flattens no `occluder` companion (its prefix set is `__shape__/__material__/__canvas_material__/__physics_material__/__navmesh_*/__viewport_mesh__/__viewport_shape__/__click_mask__/__sf_anims__/__extres__/__tile_set__/curve_points`). `light2d_scene.rs:98` uses the LOCAL `get_position`, so a torch parented to a player lights the origin. `light2d_scene.rs:120` reads a nonexistent `direction`. `crates/gdrender2d/src/occluder_polygon.rs` (with `cull_mode`) has zero callers outside its `pub use`. The guarding test `crates/gdscene/tests/light2d_scene_shading_wiring.rs:29-33` sets `polygon` by hand and so passes green over the break.

APPROACH: (1) In `packed_scene.rs`, flatten a resolved `occluder` sub-resource to `__occluder__polygon` / `__occluder__closed` / `__occluder__cull_mode` alongside the existing `__shape__*` pass. (2) In `light2d_scene.rs::collect_occluders_2d`, read the companions first (falling back to the bare `polygon` for hand-built trees), read `occluder_light_mask` (not `light_mask`), transform the points by `node2d::get_global_transform`, and populate `gdrender2d::occluder_polygon::OccluderPolygon2D` so `cull_mode` reaches the shadow pass. (3) In `collect_lights_2d`, replace `get_position` with `get_global_transform(...).origin`; derive the DirectionalLight2D vector from `get_global_rotation` per Godot; read `height`, `max_distance`, `range_z_min/max`, `range_layer_min/max` and pass them through `gdrender2d::light2d`.

WIRING: `.tscn` -> `PackedScene::from_tscn` -> `add_packed_scene_to_tree` -> `gdeditor::viewport_2d_render::build_runtime_render_list` -> `rasterize_render_list` (which already calls `gdscene::light2d_scene::collect_lights_2d/collect_occluders_2d` at `viewport_2d_render.rs:1906-1925`) -> shaded pixels.

**Merged findings (3):** Light2D / LightOccluder2D: 2D lighting is inert for any .tscn-authored scene; 2D lighting pipeline reading authored Light2D / LightOccluder2D scene properties; ClassDB registry hygiene: two non-Godot class names registered, and 26 Godot-abstract classes are instantiable

**Prove it:** Loading a .tscn that contains `[sub_resource type="OccluderPolygon2D"]` referenced by a `LightOccluder2D` under a translated `Node2D`, plus a `PointLight2D` under a translated parent, produces a framebuffer whose pixels behind the occluder (in WORLD space, i.e. offset by the parents' positions) are measurably darker than the lit side; a `DirectionalLight2D` rotated 90 degrees in the scene shades the opposite face compared to an unrotated one. (test: `light2d_occluder_subresource_shades_scene`) runnable via `cargo nextest run --test light2d_occluder_subresource_shades_scene`. The test must parse real .tscn text, not set `polygon` on the node directly.
acceptance_criteria: Loading a .tscn that contains `[sub_resource type="OccluderPolygon2D"]` referenced by a `LightOccluder2D` under a translated `Node2D`, plus a `PointLight2D` under a translated parent, produces a framebuffer whose pixels behind the occluder (in WORLD space, i.e. offset by the parents' positions) are measurably darker than the lit side; a `DirectionalLight2D` rotated 90 degrees in the scene shades the opposite face compared to an unrotated one. (test: `light2d_occluder_subresource_shades_scene`) runnable via `cargo nextest run --test light2d_occluder_subresource_shades_scene`. The test must parse real .tscn text, not set `polygon` on the node directly.

title: Register VisualShaderNode Vec2/Vec4 constants, Vec2/3/4 parameters and VectorCompose/Decompose/Distance in ClassDB
description:
[audit-key: shaders/shaders-visualshader-vector-constant-parameter-family] [port-audit 2026-07-27] [status: MISSING]

**Godot ground truth:** upstream/godot/doc/classes/VisualShaderNodeVec2Constant.xml (constant: Vector2 = Vector2(0,0)), VisualShaderNodeVec4Constant.xml (constant: Quaternion = Quaternion(0,0,0,1); extension_api.json 4.6.1 also lists constant_v4), VisualShaderNodeVec{2,3,4}Parameter.xml (default_value_enabled: bool=false + typed default_value), VisualShaderNodeVector{Compose,Decompose,Distance}.xml (all inherit VisualShaderNodeVectorBase)

**Godot classes:** VisualShaderNodeVec2Constant, VisualShaderNodeVec2Parameter, VisualShaderNodeVec3Parameter, VisualShaderNodeVec4Constant, VisualShaderNodeVec4Parameter, VisualShaderNodeVectorCompose, VisualShaderNodeVectorDecompose, VisualShaderNodeVectorDistance

**Patina today:**
- [sweep-7] Absent from ClassDB: `grep -x` for each of the 8 names against the 4186 literals extracted from engine-rs/crates/gdobject/src/class_db.rs = 0 hits. Only VisualShaderNodeVec3Constant is registered (class_db.rs:4507). The base classes are present — VisualShaderNodeVectorBase at class_db.rs:4528, VisualShaderNodeConstant at 4479, VisualShaderNodeParameter at 4847 — so this is an omission of leaves, not a missing subtree. Sharper evidence that the omission is live: engine-rs/crates/gdscene/src/visual_shader_load.rs:47 and :125 already special-case the string "VisualShaderNodeVec4Constant" when loading a VisualShader .tres (mapping it onto VisualShaderNodeType::Vec3), so the loader handles a class ClassDB does not know. Full-tree `rg -F` outside upstream/target finds the other 7 only in gdeditor/src/inspector_schema_generated.rs (a table, `rg -n 'register_class|ClassRegistration'` in that file = 0 hits) and the editor_oracle JSON fixture.

**Files:** engine-rs/crates/gdobject/src/class_db.rs, engine-rs/crates/gdscene/src/visual_shader_load.rs

**Implement / wiring requirement:**

[status: MISSING]

**Godot ground truth:** VisualShaderNodeVec2Constant (VisualShaderNodeConstant, `constant: Vector2` = Vector2(0,0)); VisualShaderNodeVec4Constant (VisualShaderNodeConstant, `constant: Quaternion` = Quaternion(0,0,0,1), plus `constant_v4` in the 4.6.1 extension_api); VisualShaderNodeVec2Parameter / Vec3Parameter / Vec4Parameter (VisualShaderNodeParameter, `default_value_enabled: bool` = false + a typed `default_value`); VisualShaderNodeVectorCompose / VectorDecompose / VectorDistance (all inherit VisualShaderNodeVectorBase, which carries the vec2/vec3/vec4 `op_type`). Sources: doc/classes/VisualShaderNodeVec*.xml, VisualShaderNodeVector*.xml, extension_api.json.

**Patina today:** only VisualShaderNodeVec3Constant is registered (class_db.rs:4507); the other 8 are absent from ClassDB. Bases already exist (VisualShaderNodeVectorBase class_db.rs:4528, VisualShaderNodeConstant 4479, VisualShaderNodeParameter 4847). The gap is already load-bearing: gdscene/src/visual_shader_load.rs:47 and :125 match the literal "VisualShaderNodeVec4Constant" when parsing a VisualShader .tres, i.e. the scene loader consumes a class ClassDB cannot describe, so the editor inspector and Create dialog (which enumerate ClassDB — gdeditor/src/create_dialog.rs) cannot show or create it.

**Implement:** add the 8 registrations to the VisualShader block in engine-rs/crates/gdobject/src/class_db.rs alongside VisualShaderNodeVec3Constant, taking parents/defaults from upstream/godot/doc/classes/*.xml. Do not re-declare `op_type` on the VectorCompose/Decompose/Distance leaves — it is inherited from VisualShaderNodeVectorBase and the property-list walk does not dedupe (see the warning at class_db.rs:5016). Vec4Constant needs both `constant` (Quaternion) and `constant_v4` per the 4.6.1 API dump.

**Wiring requirement:** a VisualShader .tres whose sub_resources include Vec2Constant/Vec3Parameter/VectorDecompose loads with each node's class resolvable through ClassDB, and the editor's ClassDB-driven create/inspector paths list them.

**Prove it:** a test asserting existence, exact parent, property defaults (including Vec4Constant's Quaternion(0,0,0,1)) and inherited-op_type-not-duplicated for all 8 classes.

**Prove it:** ClassDB reports all 8 of VisualShaderNodeVec2Constant, Vec4Constant, Vec2Parameter, Vec3Parameter, Vec4Parameter, VectorCompose, VectorDecompose and VectorDistance with their Godot 4.6.1 parents and doc-XML property defaults (Vec2Constant.constant = Vector2(0,0); Vec4Constant.constant = Quaternion(0,0,0,1); each *Parameter has default_value_enabled=false), and the three VectorBase leaves expose `op_type` exactly once in class_get_property_list (test: `visualshadernode_vec_constant_parameter_registered`)
acceptance_criteria: ClassDB reports all 8 of VisualShaderNodeVec2Constant, Vec4Constant, Vec2Parameter, Vec3Parameter, Vec4Parameter, VectorCompose, VectorDecompose and VectorDistance with their Godot 4.6.1 parents and doc-XML property defaults (Vec2Constant.constant = Vector2(0,0); Vec4Constant.constant = Quaternion(0,0,0,1); each *Parameter has default_value_enabled=false), and the three VectorBase leaves expose `op_type` exactly once in class_get_property_list (test: `visualshadernode_vec_constant_parameter_registered`)

title: Singletons: add the eight remaining names (IP, TextServerManager, NativeMenu, NavigationMeshGenerator, 4x *Manager) with web-correct behavior
description:
[audit-key: singleton-dispatch-table/fringe-singletons] [port-audit 2026-07-27] [status: MISSING]

**Godot ground truth:** upstream/godot/core/register_core_types.cpp:367 (IP — and platform/web/ip_web.h shows the WEB implementation is a no-op subclass: `_resolve_hostname` and `get_local_interfaces` have empty bodies); servers/register_server_types.cpp:152 (TextServerManager), :387 (NativeMenu), :265/:279/:306/:320 (the four *Manager singletons, 2 methods each: register_server, set_default_server); extension_api.json method counts: IP 10, TextServerManager 8, NativeMenu 68, NavigationMeshGenerator 4 | upstream/godot/core/io/ip.cpp + platform/web/ip_web.h (IPWeb::_resolve_hostname is a no-op and get_local_interfaces returns nothing, but the class and singleton exist); modules/jsonrpc/jsonrpc.cpp; doc/classes/IP.xml (resolve_hostname, resolve_hostname_addresses, resolve_hostname_queue_item, get_resolve_item_status/address/addresses, erase_resolve_item, get_local_addresses, get_local_interfaces, clear_cache), doc/classes/JSONRPC.xml

**Godot classes:** IP, TextServerManager, NativeMenu, NavigationMeshGenerator, PhysicsServer2DManager, PhysicsServer3DManager, NavigationServer2DManager, NavigationServer3DManager, JSONRPC

**Patina today:**
- [singleton-dispatch-table] `rg -c '"IP"' engine-rs/crates/gdscript-interop/src/interpreter.rs` -> 0, likewise TextServerManager, NativeMenu, NavigationMeshGenerator, PhysicsServer2DManager, PhysicsServer3DManager, NavigationServer2DManager, NavigationServer3DManager; all eight appear in the workspace only inside engine-rs/crates/gdeditor/src/inspector_schema_generated.rs; none is in `BUILTIN_SINGLETONS` (interpreter.rs:14464-14482) or engine-rs/crates/gdobject/src/class_db.rs. IP has no backing at all: `grep -rn 'resolve_hostname|get_local_addresses|get_local_interfaces|RESOLVER_STATUS' engine-rs/crates/ --include='*.rs'` -> 0 hits. NativeMenu DOES have a real 822-line implementation at engine-rs/crates/gdplatform/src/native_menu.rs (NativeMenuBar, NativeMenu, MenuItem, MenuItemKind, MenuShortcut, create_menu/add_menu/add_item/remove_item/get_item*/set_item*) whose only consumer is engine-rs/crates/gdplatform/src/macos.rs:14 — nothing in the interpreter, the runner or the editor. TextServerManager has no backing despite engine-rs/crates/gdrender2d/src/text_server.rs existing under a different name.
- [sweep-2] Both return zero hits in Patina. IP: `rg -n 'resolve_hostname|get_local_addresses|get_local_interfaces' -g '*.rs' crates/` returns nothing; 'IP' is absent from class_db.rs's string literals and from interpreter.rs BUILTIN_SINGLETONS (:14464-14483); the only occurrence anywhere is gdeditor/src/inspector_schema_generated.rs:4596 ("IP","Object"), the editor's generated parent table. JSONRPC: `rg -n '\bJSONRPC\b' -g '*.rs' crates/` returns only inspector_schema_generated.rs:4631. Scope: IP is a singleton in extension_api.json's .singletons list, and Godot's web export ships IPWeb (platform/web/ip_web.h) — resolve is a no-op, interfaces empty — so the surface exists on web and belongs in Patina per the same rule as gdobject/tests/oos_native_sockets.rs:1-16. JSONRPC is a pure dictionary-shaping helper (modules/jsonrpc) with no platform dependency at all, so nothing about it is out of scope.

**Files:** engine-rs/crates/gdscript-interop/src/interpreter.rs, engine-rs/crates/gdplatform/src/native_menu.rs, engine-rs/crates/gdrender2d/src/text_server.rs, engine-rs/crates/gdobject/src/class_db.rs, engine-rs/crates/gdscript-interop/src/global_constants.rs, engine-rs/crates/gdeditor/src/inspector_schema_generated.rs

**Implement / wiring requirement:**

GODOT GROUND TRUTH: eight of Godot 4.6.1's 39 singletons have no name in Patina at all. Crucially, most of them are SMALL on the web target, so this is a bounded bead:
- `IP` (core/register_core_types.cpp:367, 10 methods). Godot's own web build substitutes `IPWeb` (upstream/godot/platform/web/ip_web.h), whose `_resolve_hostname` and `get_local_interfaces` have EMPTY bodies — so web parity is: the singleton exists, `resolve_hostname` returns "", `resolve_hostname_addresses` and `get_local_addresses`/`get_local_interfaces` return empty arrays, and the queue API (`resolve_hostname_queue_item`, `get_resolve_item_status` -> RESOLVER_STATUS_DONE with an empty address, `erase_resolve_item`, `clear_cache`) behaves consistently. Present-and-empty, not absent.
- `TextServerManager` (servers/register_server_types.cpp:152, 8 methods): add_interface, get_interface_count, remove_interface, get_interface, get_interfaces, find_interface, set_primary_interface, get_primary_interface.
- `NativeMenu` (servers/register_server_types.cpp:387, 68 methods) is registered on ALL platforms; on web there is no global menu, so `has_feature(FEATURE_GLOBAL_MENU)` and `has_system_menu(...)` are false and the item API is bookkeeping only.
- `NavigationMeshGenerator` (4 methods) and the four `*Manager` singletons (`PhysicsServer2DManager`, `PhysicsServer3DManager`, `NavigationServer2DManager`, `NavigationServer3DManager`, servers/register_server_types.cpp:265/279/306/320) — 2 methods each (`register_server`, `set_default_server`) plus the server-name/index accessors.

PATINA CURRENT STATE: `rg -c '"IP"' engine-rs/crates/gdscript-interop/src/interpreter.rs` returns 0 and the same holds for all eight names; their only workspace occurrences are in the generated table engine-rs/crates/gdeditor/src/inspector_schema_generated.rs; none is in `BUILTIN_SINGLETONS` (interpreter.rs:14464-14482) or engine-rs/crates/gdobject/src/class_db.rs. IP has no backing whatsoever (`grep -rn 'resolve_hostname|get_local_addresses|get_local_interfaces|RESOLVER_STATUS' engine-rs/crates/` -> 0 hits). NativeMenu is the opposite case — `engine-rs/crates/gdplatform/src/native_menu.rs` is 822 lines of real menu model (NativeMenuBar, NativeMenu, MenuItem, MenuItemKind, MenuShortcut, create_menu, add_menu, add_item, remove_item, the get_item*/set_item* family) whose ONLY consumer is `engine-rs/crates/gdplatform/src/macos.rs:14`; nothing in the interpreter, runner or editor touches it.

IMPLEMENTATION: add one free `call_<name>_static` per singleton in `engine-rs/crates/gdscript-interop/src/interpreter.rs` and the matching `Expr::Ident` arms beside the existing Marshalls/ResourceUID arms (~interpreter.rs:2953). Back IP with a small module in gdplatform mirroring `IPWeb`'s empty-result contract plus a real resolver cache shape (and the `IP.RESOLVER_STATUS_*` / `IP.TYPE_*` constants in the class-scoped-enum table in global_constants.rs). Back NativeMenu with the existing `gdplatform::native_menu::NativeMenuBar` promoted to a process-global, returning false from `has_feature`/`has_system_menu`/`is_system_menu` on web while keeping create/free/add/find/get/set item bookkeeping faithful — plus the `NativeMenu.Feature`/`SystemMenus` constants. Back TextServerManager with a registry over `engine-rs/crates/gdrender2d/src/text_server.rs` (one primary interface). Give the four `*Manager` singletons real registries listing the servers Patina actually ships. Route `NavigationMeshGenerator.bake_from_source_geometry_data` into the navmesh baking already reachable from gdscene/src/navigation.rs. Add all eight to `BUILTIN_SINGLETONS` and register the classes in class_db.rs.

WIRING REQUIREMENT: every one of the eight must resolve from a script running in a loaded scene under the interpreter — a Rust-only helper is not acceptance.

**Merged findings (2):** Eight remaining singleton names absent entirely: IP, TextServerManager, NativeMenu, NavigationMeshGenerator, PhysicsServer2DManager, PhysicsServer3DManager, NavigationServer2DManager, NavigationServer3DManager; IP and JSONRPC network helper classes

**Prove it:** A script in a loaded scene calls each of the eight names and gets Godot's web-target answers rather than an UndefinedVariable error: `IP.get_local_addresses()` returns an empty Array and `IP.resolve_hostname("example.com")` returns "" (matching upstream IPWeb's empty `_resolve_hostname`), while `IP.resolve_hostname_queue_item(...)` -> `IP.get_resolve_item_status(id)` reaches `IP.RESOLVER_STATUS_DONE`; `TextServerManager.get_interface_count()` >= 1 and `get_primary_interface()` is non-null; `NativeMenu.has_feature(NativeMenu.FEATURE_GLOBAL_MENU)` is false and `has_system_menu(...)` is false, while `create_menu()` + `add_item(rid, "Open", cb)` + `get_item_count(rid)` == 1 + `get_item_text(rid, 0)` == "Open" round-trip; `PhysicsServer3DManager.get_servers_count()`-style listing names the shipped server; `NavigationMeshGenerator.bake_from_source_geometry_data(navmesh, data)` produces a navmesh a subsequent `NavigationServer2D`/agent path can use. `Engine.has_singleton(...)` is true for all eight. (test: `remaining_singletons_script_reachable` at engine-rs/crates/gdscript-interop/tests/remaining_singletons_script_reachable.rs, runnable via `cargo nextest run -p gdscript-interop --test remaining_singletons_script_reachable`)

title: Register Translation/OptimizedTranslation and load imported binary .translation resources
description:
[audit-key: theming/theming-text-translation-resource-classes] [port-audit 2026-07-27] [status: MISSING]

**Godot ground truth:** upstream/godot/doc/classes/OptimizedTranslation.xml — `inherits="Translation"`, is_instantiable=true, 1 method `generate(from: Translation)`; "Uses real-time compressed translations". This is the resource Godot's CSV/PO importers emit into `.translation` files (upstream/godot/editor/import/resource_importer_csv_translation.cpp, compress option).

**Godot classes:** OptimizedTranslation

**Patina today:**
- [sweep-4] NOT REGISTERED: `rg -n 'ClassRegistration::new("OptimizedTranslation"|ClassRegistration::new("Translation"' engine-rs apps` -> 0 hits. The sweep's own unregistered list also carries the whole family — Translation, TranslationDomain, TranslationServer, ResourceImporterCSVTranslation — so the base is missing too and any child would have a severed inheritance chain.
SOURCE-TEXT ONLY, NO RESOURCE: /Users/bone/dev/games/patina/engine-rs/crates/gdcore/src/translation.rs has a plain Rust `Translation` (:21-49), `parse_po` (:100) and `parse_csv` (:170), and a TranslationServer (:204-270). /Users/bone/dev/games/patina/engine-rs/crates/patina-runner/src/project_boot.rs:151-179 loads `internationalization/locale/translations` by reading each path with `std::fs::read_to_string` and branching on `.csv` vs everything-else-is-a-.po — so an entry pointing at an IMPORTED binary `.translation` (which is what Godot's own project.godot lists after import) is fed to the .po text parser and silently yields an empty catalog (the loop `continue`s or produces no messages; project_boot.rs:162-164 only warns on unreadable files).
NO BINARY DECODER: `rg -n 'OptimizedTranslation|PHashTranslation|\.translation' engine-rs --glob '!*fixtures*'` -> only the project_boot.rs:143 comment naming `.translation` and gdcore/translation.rs internals. No hash-table/compressed-bucket decoder exists.

**Files:** engine-rs/crates/gdobject/src/class_db.rs, engine-rs/crates/gdcore/src/translation.rs, engine-rs/crates/patina-runner/src/project_boot.rs

**Implement / wiring requirement:**

Godot's import pipeline turns a .po/.csv into a binary `.translation` resource — an `OptimizedTranslation` (compressed hash buckets) when the importer's `compress` option is on, a plain `Translation` otherwise — and `internationalization/locale/translations` in project.godot points at THOSE files, not the sources.

Patina registers neither class (`rg 'ClassRegistration::new("Translation"' engine-rs apps` -> 0) and patina-runner/src/project_boot.rs:151-179 handles only source text: `.csv` goes to parse_csv, and literally everything else is fed to `parse_po` with the file stem as the locale. A real exported project's `.translation` entries therefore parse to an empty catalog and every `tr()` degrades to the key — silently, because project_boot.rs only warns when the file is unreadable.

Register `Translation` (Resource; get_message/set_message/erase_message/get_message_list/get_message_count/get_translated_message_list, `locale` property) and `OptimizedTranslation` (Translation; `generate(from)`), add a decoder for the binary resource format (hash table + bucket-compressed strings, upstream/godot/core/string/optimized_translation.cpp), and make load_project_translations dispatch on the real resource type rather than the file extension.

Ground truth: upstream/godot/doc/classes/OptimizedTranslation.xml, Translation.xml; upstream/godot/core/string/optimized_translation.cpp; upstream/godot/editor/import/resource_importer_csv_translation.cpp.

**Prove it:** 1. `ClassDB.class_exists("Translation")` and `class_exists("OptimizedTranslation")` are true, OptimizedTranslation's parent is Translation, and the chain walks Translation -> Resource -> RefCounted -> Object unbroken.
2. `load("res://x.translation")` on a fixture produced by Godot 4.6.1's CSV importer (compress=on) returns an OptimizedTranslation whose `get_message(key)` returns the expected string for at least three keys, including one that hashes into a collision bucket.
3. A plain (uncompressed) `.translation` loads as a Translation and answers get_message_list()/get_message_count(); an OptimizedTranslation returns an EMPTY list and count 0 from those two, exactly as the doc XML specifies.
4. patina-runner boots a project whose `internationalization/locale/translations` lists a binary `.translation`, and `tr("KEY")` in a script returns the translated string — today it returns the key.
5. A malformed/truncated .translation is skipped with a warning and does not abort the boot, matching the existing degrade at project_boot.rs:162-164 (test: `optimized_translation_resource_load_and_tr`)
acceptance_criteria:
1. `ClassDB.class_exists("Translation")` and `class_exists("OptimizedTranslation")` are true, OptimizedTranslation's parent is Translation, and the chain walks Translation -> Resource -> RefCounted -> Object unbroken.
2. `load("res://x.translation")` on a fixture produced by Godot 4.6.1's CSV importer (compress=on) returns an OptimizedTranslation whose `get_message(key)` returns the expected string for at least three keys, including one that hashes into a collision bucket.
3. A plain (uncompressed) `.translation` loads as a Translation and answers get_message_list()/get_message_count(); an OptimizedTranslation returns an EMPTY list and count 0 from those two, exactly as the doc XML specifies.
4. patina-runner boots a project whose `internationalization/locale/translations` lists a binary `.translation`, and `tr("KEY")` in a script returns the translated string — today it returns the key.
5. A malformed/truncated .translation is skipped with a warning and does not abort the boot, matching the existing degrade at project_boot.rs:162-164 (test: `optimized_translation_resource_load_and_tr`)

title: Fonts: load WOFF/WOFF2, BMFont and image fonts, and honor FontFile rasterization settings
description:
[audit-key: theming-text/font-format-coverage] [port-audit 2026-07-27] [status: MISSING]

**Godot ground truth:** scene/resources/font.cpp FontFile::load_dynamic_font/load_bitmap_font; modules/text_server_adv (MSDF generation, hinting, subpixel positioning, LCD layouts); doc/classes/FontFile.xml (antialiasing, hinting, subpixel_positioning, oversampling, multichannel_signed_distance_field + msdf_pixel_range/msdf_size, fixed_size + fixed_size_scale_mode, opentype_feature_overrides, generate_mipmaps, force_autohinter); ResourceImporterBMFont / ResourceImporterImageFont; ProjectSettings gui/theme/lcd_subpixel_layout

**Godot classes:** FontFile, ResourceImporterBMFont, ResourceImporterImageFont, ResourceImporterDynamicFont

**Patina today:**
- [theming-text] engine-rs/crates/gdresource/src/importers.rs:762-763 registers exactly two font extensions: `rfl.register(".ttf", import_font); rfl.register(".otf", import_font);`. grep `woff|\\.fnt|BMFont` over engine-rs/crates/gdresource/src and engine-rs/crates/gdrender2d/src returns nothing. Rasterization is plain grayscale coverage via `ab_glyph` (engine-rs/crates/gdrender2d/src/ttf_font.rs:107 `rasterize`) — no MSDF, no hinting control, no subpixel positioning, no oversampling, no LCD layout, no mipmaps. The FontFile ClassDB entry declares msdf_pixel_range/msdf_size/multichannel_signed_distance_field/hinting/subpixel_positioning/oversampling/fixed_size/fixed_size_scale_mode/opentype_feature_overrides as properties (engine-rs/crates/gdobject/src/class_db.rs:5769-5813) that nothing reads. ResourceImporterBMFont/ResourceImporterDynamicFont/ResourceImporterImageFont are all in the audit's unregistered.txt.

**Files:** engine-rs/crates/gdresource/src/importers.rs, engine-rs/crates/gdrender2d/src/ttf_font.rs, engine-rs/crates/gdobject/src/class_db.rs

**Implement / wiring requirement:**

GODOT: FontFile::load_dynamic_font accepts TTF/OTF/WOFF/WOFF2/PFB/PFM, and load_bitmap_font accepts BMFont .fnt/.font (text and binary) plus image fonts (ResourceImporterImageFont). Rasterization honors `antialiasing` (None/Gray/LCD + gui/theme/lcd_subpixel_layout), `hinting`, `subpixel_positioning`, `oversampling`, `generate_mipmaps`, `force_autohinter`, `fixed_size` + `fixed_size_scale_mode`, `multichannel_signed_distance_field` with `msdf_pixel_range`/`msdf_size`, and `opentype_feature_overrides`.\n\nPATINA: only two extensions load. engine-rs/crates/gdresource/src/importers.rs:762-763 registers `.ttf` and `.otf` and nothing else; grep for `woff|.fnt|BMFont` across engine-rs/crates/gdresource/src and engine-rs/crates/gdrender2d/src returns zero hits. Rasterization is a single grayscale path through `ab_glyph` (engine-rs/crates/gdrender2d/src/ttf_font.rs:107). Every one of the settings above is declared as a ClassDB property (engine-rs/crates/gdobject/src/class_db.rs:5769-5813) with no consumer. This matters most on the web target, where WOFF2 is the common shipping format.\n\nIMPLEMENTATION: (1) add a WOFF/WOFF2 decompressor (e.g. `woff2`/`brotli` crate) in engine-rs/crates/gdresource/src/importers.rs that unpacks to SFNT bytes before handing them to the TTF path, and register `.woff`/`.woff2`; (2) add a BMFont parser (text + binary `.fnt`, page textures, kerning pairs) and an image-font loader producing a `BitmapFont` (engine-rs/crates/gdrender2d/src/font.rs:367 already has the struct) and register `.fnt`/`.font`; (3) thread the FontFile settings into engine-rs/crates/gdrender2d/src/ttf_font.rs: subpixel positioning (fractional pen x → separate atlas entries), oversampling (raster at N× then downsample), fixed_size + scale mode, and an MSDF generation path keyed by msdf_size/msdf_pixel_range with an MSDF-aware sampling shader/blit; (4) apply `opentype_feature_overrides` through the shaping layer from the TextServer bead; (5) register ResourceImporterBMFont/DynamicFont/ImageFont in engine-rs/crates/gdobject/src/class_db.rs.\n\nWIRING: a .tscn whose Label sets `theme_override_fonts/font` to a .woff2 or a BMFont .fnt renders glyphs from that face in the viewport, not the built-in fallback.

**Prove it:** A Label whose theme_override_fonts/font points at a .woff2 resource renders glyphs whose measured width differs from the built-in fallback (proving the face loaded, not silently fell back); a BMFont .fnt plus its page PNG loads and draws its glyphs with the file's declared kerning; setting `subpixel_positioning` on a FontFile changes the glyph raster for a fractional pen position; `multichannel_signed_distance_field = true` produces an MSDF atlas entry that stays sharp when the same glyph is drawn at 4x size. title: StyleBox: draw skew, corner_detail, anti-aliasing and border blending; add StyleBoxTexture.region_rect
description:
[audit-key: theming-text/stylebox-render-fidelity] [port-audit 2026-07-27] [status: PARTIAL]

**Godot ground truth:** scene/resources/style_box_flat.cpp StyleBoxFlat::draw (skew shear, adapt_values, corner detail tessellation, aa_size feathering, blend_border gradient); scene/resources/style_box_texture.cpp (region_rect); doc/classes/StyleBox.xml draw()/get_draw_rect()/test_mask()

**Godot classes:** StyleBoxFlat, StyleBoxTexture, StyleBox, CanvasItem

**Patina today:**
- [theming-text] engine-rs/crates/gdscene/src/stylebox.rs:97-101 documents anti_aliasing as "Stored and parsed, **not yet honoured**". grep `corner_detail|\\.skew|anti_aliasing|aa_size|border_blend` over engine-rs/crates shows they appear ONLY as struct fields (stylebox.rs:84-122), parse sites (:632-642) and unit-test assertions (:1177-1197) — `StyleBoxFlat::draw` (stylebox.rs:138-197) never reads `skew`, `corner_detail`, `border_blend`, `anti_aliasing` or `aa_size`. `StyleBoxTexture` (stylebox.rs:202-217) has no `region_rect` field, so an atlas-sourced stylebox draws the whole texture. `StyleBox::draw` (stylebox.rs:391) is a Rust-only method — grep of engine-rs/crates/gdscript-interop/src/interpreter.rs for `draw_style_box` returns nothing, so CanvasItem.draw_style_box() is unavailable to scripts.

**Files:** engine-rs/crates/gdscene/src/stylebox.rs, engine-rs/crates/gdrender2d/src/draw.rs

**Implement / wiring requirement:**

GODOT: StyleBoxFlat::draw (scene/resources/style_box_flat.cpp) shears the box by `skew`, tessellates each corner with `corner_detail` segments, feathers the outline over `anti_aliasing_size` pixels when `anti_aliasing` is on, and gradients border→bg when `border_blend` is set. StyleBoxTexture has a `region_rect` selecting a sub-rect of an atlas texture. Scripts draw styleboxes directly with CanvasItem.draw_style_box() / StyleBox.draw().\n\nPATINA: all five StyleBoxFlat knobs are parsed and unit-tested but never used at draw. engine-rs/crates/gdscene/src/stylebox.rs:97-101 says so verbatim for anti_aliasing; `StyleBoxFlat::draw` at stylebox.rs:138-197 reads only bg_color, border_width/color, corner_radius, expand_margin, shadow_* and draw_center. `skew` is declared at :93 and read nowhere outside the parser (:632-642) and tests (:1177-1197). StyleBoxTexture (stylebox.rs:202-217) has no `region_rect`, so atlas-based theme styleboxes stretch the entire source image. `draw_style_box` is absent from the interpreter.\n\nIMPLEMENTATION: (1) apply `skew` as a shear on the emitted rounded-rect vertices in engine-rs/crates/gdscene/src/stylebox.rs `push_rounded_per_corner`; (2) drive corner tessellation from `corner_detail` instead of the fixed segment count and emit a feathered outer ring of `aa_size` px when `anti_aliasing` is set (needs a coverage-aware polygon fill in engine-rs/crates/gdrender2d/src/draw.rs or per-vertex alpha on the polygon command); (3) implement `border_blend` as a per-vertex color gradient between border_color and bg_color; (4) add `region_rect: Rect2` to StyleBoxTexture, parse `region_rect` in `stylebox_from_props`, and pass a source rect through `DrawCommand::DrawNinePatch` into `draw::draw_nine_patch_axes`; (5) expose `CanvasItem.draw_style_box(stylebox, rect)` in engine-rs/crates/gdscript-interop/src/interpreter.rs.\n\nWIRING: a .tscn Panel with a StyleBoxFlat sub-resource carrying skew=(0.3,0) and corner_detail=2 renders sheared, coarsely-rounded pixels in the viewport; an atlas-backed StyleBoxTexture with region_rect draws only that sub-rect.

title: Particles: apply attractor forces and box/sphere collision response in the CPU simulators
description:
[audit-key: vfx-particles/particles-attractors-collision] [port-audit 2026-07-27] [status: MISSING]

**Godot ground truth:** extension_api.json GPUParticlesAttractor3D (strength, attenuation, directionality, cull_mask) + Box3D/Sphere3D/VectorField3D; GPUParticlesCollision3D (cull_mask) + Box3D/Sphere3D/HeightField3D/SDF3D; ParticleProcessMaterial.collision_mode (COLLISION_DISABLED/RIGID/HIDE_ON_CONTACT), collision_friction, collision_bounce, collision_use_scale, attractor_interaction_enabled; upstream/godot/scene/3d/gpu_particles_attractor_3d.cpp, gpu_particles_collision_3d.cpp

**Godot classes:** GPUParticlesAttractor3D, GPUParticlesAttractorBox3D, GPUParticlesAttractorSphere3D, GPUParticlesAttractorVectorField3D, GPUParticlesCollision3D, GPUParticlesCollisionBox3D, GPUParticlesCollisionSphere3D, GPUParticlesCollisionHeightField3D, GPUParticlesCollisionSDF3D, ParticleProcessMaterial

**Patina today:**
- [vfx-particles] All 8 classes are ClassDB-registered but have no simulation whatsoever: `grep -rn 'GPUParticlesAttractor|GPUParticlesCollision|attractor' /Users/bone/dev/games/patina/engine-rs/crates/gdscene/src/ /Users/bone/dev/games/patina/engine-rs/crates/gdserver3d/src/ /Users/bone/dev/games/patina/engine-rs/crates/gdserver2d/src/` returns only two unrelated hits in gdscene/src/physics_server.rs:1421,1423 about Area2D point gravity. The simulators have no collider or attractor input at all — `ParticleSimulator::step_exact` (particle.rs:647-796) applies only gravity, and `grep -c 'collision_mode\|collision_friction\|collision_bounce\|particle_flag' gdscene/src/main_loop.rs` = 0. The module doc at /Users/bone/dev/games/patina/engine-rs/crates/gdscene/src/particle.rs:20-24 states it: "This module has no collider input at all: a particle's only per-step force is gravity, so particles pass through every body in the scene. collision_mode/collision_friction/collision_bounce are unhonored." The tests confirm registration-only scope: /Users/bone/dev/games/patina/engine-rs/crates/gdobject/tests/particle_attractor_classes_test.rs:3-6 ("The simulator half ... is follow-up") and /Users/bone/dev/games/patina/engine-rs/crates/gdobject/tests/particles_collision.rs:12-14 ("SCOPE: registration only ... attractor forces and box/sphere bounce in the CPU sim, wired through process_particles — NOT delivered").

**Files:** /Users/bone/dev/games/patina/engine-rs/crates/gdscene/src/particle.rs, /Users/bone/dev/games/patina/engine-rs/crates/gdscene/src/particle3d.rs, /Users/bone/dev/games/patina/engine-rs/crates/gdscene/src/main_loop.rs, /Users/bone/dev/games/patina/engine-rs/crates/gdobject/src/class_db.rs

**Implement / wiring requirement:**

GODOT GROUND TRUTH: GPUParticlesAttractor3D nodes pull or push particles within their volume — `strength` (negative repels), `attenuation` (falloff exponent over the normalized distance), `directionality` (0 = radial toward the attractor center, 1 = along the attractor's -Z axis), `cull_mask` (matched against the emitter's layers). Shapes: Box3D (`size`), Sphere3D (`radius`), VectorField3D (`size` + a `texture` of per-cell directions). Attractors only affect emitters whose material has `attractor_interaction_enabled`. GPUParticlesCollision3D nodes stop particles: Box3D/Sphere3D analytic volumes, HeightField3D, SDF3D baked field. The response is chosen by ParticleProcessMaterial.collision_mode — COLLISION_DISABLED(0), COLLISION_RIGID(1) which bounces using `collision_bounce` and `collision_friction`, COLLISION_HIDE_ON_CONTACT(2) which kills the particle — with `collision_use_scale` scaling the particle's collision radius by its scale. See upstream/godot/scene/3d/gpu_particles_attractor_3d.cpp and gpu_particles_collision_3d.cpp.\n\nPATINA CURRENT STATE: all eight classes are registered in ClassDB and instantiate with the right properties, but nothing simulates them. `grep -rn 'GPUParticlesAttractor|GPUParticlesCollision|attractor' gdscene/src/ gdserver3d/src/ gdserver2d/src/` returns only two unrelated Area2D point-gravity comments (gdscene/src/physics_server.rs:1421,1423). `ParticleSimulator::step_exact` (gdscene/src/particle.rs:647-796) applies gravity and nothing else — there is no collider or attractor input parameter on the function at all. main_loop.rs never reads collision_mode/collision_friction/collision_bounce/attractor_interaction_enabled (all grep counts 0). The module doc at particle.rs:20-24 admits particles "pass through every body in the scene". The tests are explicit about being registration-only: gdobject/tests/particle_attractor_classes_test.rs:3-6 and gdobject/tests/particles_collision.rs:12-14.\n\nIMPLEMENTATION — STAGE THIS BEAD; stage 1 covers attractors + analytic box/sphere collision (VectorField, HeightField and SDF are follow-ups): (1) Define a `ParticleField` input struct in gdscene/src/particle3d.rs holding the frame's attractor volumes (global transform, shape, strength, attenuation, directionality, cull_mask) and collider volumes (global transform, shape, cull_mask), plus the emitter's collision_mode/friction/bounce/use_scale. (2) Change `ParticleSimulator3D::step` to accept `&ParticleField` and, inside the integration loop, add each in-range attractor's acceleration before the position update, then resolve collisions after it: for COLLISION_RIGID reflect the velocity about the contact normal scaled by `collision_bounce` and damp the tangential component by `collision_friction`, pushing the particle back out of the volume; for COLLISION_HIDE_ON_CONTACT mark the particle dead. (3) In gdscene/src/main_loop.rs `process_particles` (:645), collect GPUParticlesAttractor*3D and GPUParticlesCollision*3D nodes from the tree in the same pass that collects emitters (:662-673), build the `ParticleField` from their global transforms, and pass it to each 3D simulator step at :915-925. (4) Mirror a 2D subset (circle/rect attractors and colliders) into gdscene/src/particle.rs, which is the path 2D emitters use, so the feature is not 3D-only. (5) Record AT_COLLISION sub-emitter events at the contact point, which makes `SubEmitterMode::AtCollision` (already defined at particle.rs:395-397 and currently inert) live.\n\nWIRING REQUIREMENT: a plain `.tscn` containing an emitter plus an attractor/collider sibling → MainLoop::step → the published particle positions bend toward the attractor and stop at the collider surface.

**Prove it:** A .tscn with a GPUParticles3D firing straight up and a GPUParticlesAttractorSphere3D offset to one side bends the cloud toward the attractor, while the identical scene with `strength` negated bends it away — and with the attractor deleted the cloud stays straight. A GPUParticlesCollisionBox3D placed in the fall path of a gravity-driven emitter stops the particles at its surface instead of letting them pass through. Test `particle_attractors_and_collision_in_scene` (cargo nextest --test particle_attractors_and_collision_in_scene) loads each scene, steps MainLoop 90 frames, reads MainLoop::particle_positions_3d, and asserts (a) mean particle x is displaced toward the attractor by more than one attractor radius vs the no-attractor control, (b) the negated-strength case is displaced the opposite way, (c) with a collider at y = -50 and COLLISION_RIGID, no particle's y goes below -50 minus the collision radius, whereas the collision-disabled control has particles well below it, and (d) COLLISION_HIDE_ON_CONTACT drops the live count to zero after contact (test: `particle_attractors_and_collision_in_scene`)
acceptance_criteria: A .tscn with a GPUParticles3D firing straight up and a GPUParticlesAttractorSphere3D offset to one side bends the cloud toward the attractor, while the identical scene with `strength` negated bends it away — and with the attractor deleted the cloud stays straight. A GPUParticlesCollisionBox3D placed in the fall path of a gravity-driven emitter stops the particles at its surface instead of letting them pass through. Test `particle_attractors_and_collision_in_scene` (cargo nextest --test particle_attractors_and_collision_in_scene) loads each scene, steps MainLoop 90 frames, reads MainLoop::particle_positions_3d, and asserts (a) mean particle x is displaced toward the attractor by more than one attractor radius vs the no-attractor control, (b) the negated-strength case is displaced the opposite way, (c) with a collider at y = -50 and COLLISION_RIGID, no particle's y goes below -50 minus the collision radius, whereas the collision-disabled control has particles well below it, and (d) COLLISION_HIDE_ON_CONTACT drops the live count to zero after contact (test: `particle_attractors_and_collision_in_scene`)

title: Web: threaded export variant — worker-backed WorkerThreadPool, honest has_feature("threads"), SAB audio ring
description:
[audit-key: web-runtime/web-threads] [port-audit 2026-07-27] [status: UNWIRED/MISSING]

**Godot ground truth:** upstream/godot/platform/web/detect.py (thread_support build variant) + platform/web/js/libs/library_godot_audio.js (SAB ring for the audio worklet) + Godot docs "Exporting for the Web" cross-origin isolation section | extension_api.json classes[Thread,Mutex,Semaphore,WorkerThreadPool]; upstream/godot/core/object/worker_thread_pool.cpp (real task threads when THREADS_ENABLED); Godot's web export supports threads under cross-origin isolation

**Godot classes:** Thread, Mutex, Semaphore, WorkerThreadPool, OS

**Patina today:**
- [web-runtime] crates/gdplatform/src/thread.rs contains no target gating at all (`rg 'target_arch|wasm' crates/gdplatform/src/thread.rs` → 0 hits), so the Thread/Mutex/WorkerThreadPool surface is plain std::thread with no browser Worker path and no single-thread fallback scheduler. `OS.has_feature("threads")` is hardcoded to false on web regardless of the export variant: crates/gdplatform/src/os.rs:92-93 `"threads" => platform != Platform::Web`. The audio worklet uses main-thread message-port block passing only (crates/gdaudio/src/web_output.rs:310-315 `this.port.postMessage("need-block")` / node.port.onmessage), never a SharedArrayBuffer ring, even though cross-origin isolation is already available in the editor dev server (crates/gdeditor/src/editor_server.rs:2973). The export's threads flag only emits an HTML comment and a message (crates/gdplatform/src/export.rs:632-639, 1227-1232) — no actual threaded build variant exists.
- [platform-os] engine-rs/crates/gdscript-interop/src/interpreter.rs:17417-17432 states the design: Thread/WorkerThreadPool Callables run inline on the calling thread, so a task is complete before its id is returned, `wait_*` is a no-op and `Semaphore.wait()` cannot block. engine-rs/crates/gdplatform/src/thread.rs (615 lines: GodotThread, GodotMutex, GodotSemaphore, WorkerThreadPool with real `std::thread`) has ZERO non-test consumers — `grep -rn 'gdplatform::thread' crates/` outside the defining file returns only a test doc-comment (engine-rs/crates/gdscript-interop/tests/threading.rs:12) and the explanatory comment at interpreter.rs:17424. Nothing in the engine itself (resource loading, navmesh baking, rendering) uses the pool either. Notably the cross-origin isolation half IS done — engine-rs/crates/gdeditor/src/editor_server.rs:2973 serves `Cross-Origin-Opener-Policy: same-origin` + `Cross-Origin-Embedder-Policy: require-corp` — so `crossOriginIsolated`/SharedArrayBuffer is reachable and only the thread side is missing. `Thread.set_thread_safety_checks_enabled` is absent (the Thread dispatch covers start/get_id/is_started/is_alive/wait_to_finish/is_main_thread only).

**Files:** engine-rs/crates/gdplatform/src/thread.rs, engine-rs/crates/gdplatform/src/os.rs, engine-rs/crates/gdaudio/src/web_output.rs, engine-rs/crates/gdplatform/src/export.rs, engine-rs/crates/gdscript-interop/src/interpreter.rs, engine-rs/crates/gdeditor/src/editor_server.rs

**Implement / wiring requirement:**

GROUND TRUTH — Godot ships a `thread_support` web build variant (platform/web/detect.py) that requires COOP/COEP cross-origin isolation; with it, Thread/WorkerThreadPool run on real Web Workers, `OS.has_feature("threads")` is true, and the audio driver feeds the worklet through a SharedArrayBuffer ring instead of message passing (platform/web/js/libs/library_godot_audio.js). Without it the engine runs single-threaded and the feature tag is false. PATINA — engine-rs/crates/gdplatform/src/thread.rs has no target gating whatsoever (`rg 'target_arch|wasm' crates/gdplatform/src/thread.rs` → 0 hits), so there is neither a worker path nor a documented single-thread fallback; `OS.has_feature("threads")` is hardcoded false on web (crates/gdplatform/src/os.rs:92-93) so a threaded export could never report itself; the audio worklet is message-port only (crates/gdaudio/src/web_output.rs:310-315) despite the editor already serving COOP/COEP (crates/gdeditor/src/editor_server.rs:2973); and the export's `threads_enabled` flag emits only an HTML comment and a log line (crates/gdplatform/src/export.rs:632-639, 1227-1232). APPROACH — (1) make `has_feature("threads")` read a runtime capability set by the wasm entry from `self.crossOriginIsolated`, not the target; (2) give crates/gdplatform/src/thread.rs a wasm32 path with a cooperative single-thread fallback scheduler (tasks drained on the frame tick) so `WorkerThreadPool` group tasks complete deterministically without threads, and a worker-backed path behind the threaded variant; (3) add a SharedArrayBuffer ring to crates/gdaudio/src/web_output.rs's worklet glue, used when isolated and falling back to the current postMessage path otherwise. WIRING — required path: script calls `WorkerThreadPool.add_group_task(...)` in a scene under the wasm engine handle; the tasks complete and `wait_for_group_task_completion` returns on both the isolated and non-isolated paths.

**Merged findings (2):** Threads on web: SharedArrayBuffer / wasm-threads WorkerThreadPool, has_feature("threads"), SAB audio ring; Threading: Thread/WorkerThreadPool run Callables inline; gdplatform::thread (real OS threads) has no call path; Thread.set_thread_safety_checks_enabled missing

**Prove it:** With cross-origin isolation reported off, `OS.has_feature("threads")` is false, `WorkerThreadPool` group tasks still all complete via the cooperative scheduler within the frame tick, and the audio worklet glue uses the message-port path; with it reported on, the feature tag is true and the emitted worklet glue uses a SharedArrayBuffer ring. Test: `web_threads_and_shared_memory_story`, runnable via `cargo nextest run -p gdplatform --test web_threads_and_shared_memory_story` (test: `web_threads_and_shared_memory_story`)
acceptance_criteria: With cross-origin isolation reported off, `OS.has_feature("threads")` is false, `WorkerThreadPool` group tasks still all complete via the cooperative scheduler within the frame tick, and the audio worklet glue uses the message-port path; with it reported on, the feature tag is true and the emitted worklet glue uses a SharedArrayBuffer ring. Test: `web_threads_and_shared_memory_story`, runnable via `cargo nextest run -p gdplatform --test web_threads_and_shared_memory_story` (test: `web_threads_and_shared_memory_story`)
